claims.title: Maxwell–Stefan global weak controlled homogenization and boundary-safe local structure

quoted_fields.interface: UnitT3 ideal equal-molar normalized Maxwell–Stefan transport without reactions, arbitrary finite N>=2 and positive rational symmetric f_ij, nonnegative simplex data with positive species means (original smooth C3<=K class included), smooth prescribed divergence-free b. The constructed steady rational-trigonometric entropy controller is common to the supplied initial-profile class.
quoted_fields.failure: The entropy contraction does not prove global strong solvability, higher-derivative continuation or positive-time strict positivity for unrestricted N and frictions. For weak solutions it requires the stated entropy/flux regularity supporting the comparison. Imported general weak existence and ternary strong results are credited once, not claimed as new arbitrary-component closure. The source preserves its formatting defects. No same-model counterexample, scientific novelty or new independent Capital verification is asserted. CONTINUATION: This is an obstruction to THAT spectral-coordinate representation, not a universal Maxwell–Stefan/controller no-go. The all-component entropy estimate remains conditional on appropriate entropy-admissible solvability; it supplies no higher-derivative continuation. New Darken/additive-friction primary contracts are retained only at their restricted coefficient, initial-positivity, domain and unforced scopes; no automatic arbitrary-friction/periodic-advection/initial-zero transfer. CONTINUATION: Global weak existence and arbitrary entropy rate do not imply weak uniqueness, strong continuation, positive-time global classical smoothness or a uniform density/gradient floor. Local positivity holds only on existing smooth intervals. The static bump is a norm-implication obstruction, not a singular PDE trajectory or a model-wide no-go. Mature parabolic/entropy/structured-friction machinery is credited once; no new novelty, physical-device or model-winner claim.
